```yaml
name: Update Compat Table Dependency

on:
  schedule:
    - cron: '0 0 * * 1' # Weekly on Monday at 00:00 UTC
  workflow_dispatch:

jobs:
  update-compat-table:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

    steps:
      - name: Checkout repository
        uses: actions/checkout@v3

      - name: Set up Node.js
        uses: actions/setup-node@v3
        with:
          node-version: '16'

      - name: Install dependencies
        run: pnpm install

      - name: Fetch latest SHA from compat-table/compat-table
        id: fetch-sha
        run: |
          curl -s https://api.github.com/repos/compat-table/compat-table/commits/main | jq -r '.sha'
        env:
          GITHUB_TOKEN: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}

      - name: Compare SHAs
        id: compare-shas
        run: |
          CURRENT_SHA=$(jq -r '.version' tasks/compat_data/package.json)
          LATEST_SHA=${{ steps.fetch-sha.outputs.sha }}
          if [ "$CURRENT_SHA" != "$LATEST_SHA" ]; then
            echo "::set-output name=update_required::true"
            echo "::set-output name=new_sha::$LATEST_SHA"
          else
            echo "::set-output name=update_required::false"
          fi

      - name: Update package.json if necessary
        if: steps.compare-shas.outputs.update_required == 'true'
        run: |
          sed -i '' "s|\"version\": \"[^\"]*\"|\"version\": \"$${steps.compare-shas.outputs.new_sha}\"|" tasks/compat_data/package.json

      - name: Run build process
        if: steps.compare-shas.outputs.update_required == 'true'
        run: pnpm run init && pnpm run build

      - name: Create pull request
        if: steps.compare-shas.outputs.update_required == 'true'
        uses: peter-evans/create-pull-request@v4
        with:
          token: ${{ secrets.GITHUB_TOKEN }}
          branch: update-compat-table
          title: chore: update compat-table to latest commit
          commit-message: chore: update compat-table to ${steps.compare-shas.outputs.new_sha}
          body: |
            Updated the compat-table dependency to the latest commit.
            
            - New SHA: ${steps.compare-shas.outputs.new_sha}
          assignees: Boshen
```
